The fine print, in plain words
Readings are for entertainment only — not medical, mental-health, financial, legal or relationship advice.
Readings are written by AI on your phone and can be wrong or odd.
We don\'t run background checks or verify anyone. You\'re responsible for your own safety when you chat with or meet people.
There\'s no Conjunction server. Nearby talks straight to nearby phones over Bluetooth, and what you send stays on their phones.
You give up some rights to sue us, and US disputes go to individual arbitration (no class actions) unless you opt out within 30 days.
Some rights can\'t be waived where you live; those stay with you.

Nearby Conjunctions
Nearby uses Bluetooth to find people close by who also turned Nearby on. When one of them is compatible, you both get a match card. There\'s no server: phones talk to each other directly.
While Nearby is on, your phone uses Bluetooth, even when Conjunction is closed. It doesn\'t use your location, and no one sees a distance.

To check for a match, your phone sends every nearby phone with Nearby on: your gender and who you seek, relationship status, what you\'re looking for, chart positions, birth date and birth hour, and your blood type if you chose to add it. Never your name, birth place, birth minute or location. These details together are close to unique, so someone who keeps scanning near you could recognise you again.

If you match, it also sends your first name, bio line and photo. They see your card before either of you accepts: photo, first name, age, signs, Chinese animal, relationship status and what you\'re looking for.
This isn\'t encrypted until you both accept, and we can\'t control other phones: a modified app could keep what you send. Only add what you\'re happy for strangers nearby to see.
Swipe right to accept, left to pass. Chat opens only when you both swipe right. Chats are end-to-end encrypted and stay on your two phones.
